svg.text: SOFTWARE — a wrong guess costs seconds, so guessing is cheap
THIS PROJECT — a wrong guess costs most of a day
and DDR is volatile: a power-cycle wipes both the scene AND every runtime knob
Consequence: the agent cannot brute-force. Every board trip must be earned by a board-free proof first,
and each trip must be instrumented to answer more than one question.
